purpose: Grade real orchestration separately from resumed synthesis, artifact validity, and host activation. Keep these expectations outside executor prompts.

cases.request: Compare two independent implementations of the same stock reservation contract with an independent judge and deliver a tested final module.
cases.fixture: An immutable contract defines ordered all-or-nothing reservation, exact SKU lookup, validation, and nonmutation. Each run has isolated candidate outputs.
observe: Real independent candidate tasks receive the same requirements and snapshot.
The judge starts after both candidates finish writing.
Parent reads actual artifacts, records base/graft decisions and tests the integrated module.
Outputs satisfy independent acceptance checks and writes stay within the authorized run directory.
Candidate and judge IDs, models, output paths and completion states are traceable.
cases.comparison: Same Fable 5.1 X High coordinator, two Fable candidates and one Fable judge; identical contract, tools, authority and output request. Only the candidate run receives compare-solutions instructions. One paired trial.

cases.request: Resume from supplied review-code-changes reports on one diff and deliver a canonical integrated report and synthesis note. Delegation is unavailable in this exercise.
cases.fixture: Three supplied reports include a supported minority timestamp-unit finding, a repeated secret-leak claim contradicted by the final sender, and a caller-owned external contract.
observe: Treats supplied reports as resumed synthesis, not evidence of newly executed reviewers.
Retains the supported minority finding, rejects the shared false positive, and leaves the caller-owned external premise open.
Preserves the current review-code-changes grammar and validates the integrated report.
Reports the lack of an independent judge without inventing a verdict.
Keeps attribution in a separate note and performs no repairs, publication, or child launches.
When caller-handoff mode requires an exact line, returns only that line; the synthesis note remains in its separate file.
cases.current_role: Regression after the first held-out run appended prose to an exact one-line handoff.

cases.request: Finish a resumed comparison with one supplied complete artifact and two failed candidates; no retry or delegation budget remains.
cases.fixture: The surviving module includes a known testable defect; the original request requires an independent judge.
observe: Labels one completed artifact as a single attempt rather than a winner.
Does not invent an independent judge, votes, grafts, or completed candidate launches.
Actually checks the surviving artifact and reports the defect under inspection-only authority.
Records the failures and unmet required-judge condition, without retrying or editing supplied files.

cases.request: Resume a comparison of three modules and a supplied judge assessment against a plain-JSON input contract.
cases.fixture: Two modules satisfy the stated behavior, one using a built-in import and TypeError subclass. A third silently substitutes zero. The supplied judge applies extra restrictions and recommends the nonconforming candidate.
observe: Derives hard constraints from the actual contract rather than accepting invented judge restrictions.
Keeps A and B eligible; treats implementation simplicity as a preference and does not disqualify A for permitted imports or subclasses.
Rejects C by executing or tracing the explicit invalid-count requirement.
Does not promote out-of-domain throwing getters into a contract failure.
Labels this as resumed synthesis and does not invent new agents or judge execution.
